page.layout: Top: two oval woodcut medallions side by side, each with a portrait and marginal legend (left: Felix, right: Drusilla). Below them: one block of running text, full width, with a paragraph on Felix and a second paragraph on Drusilla. Below the text: the signature at the right. Bottom centre: an ornament with no text. No notes in either margin.

main_text.l: PRAEFECT. FELIX · IVD[?]
DRVSILLA · FEL. V[?]
FELIX constitutus est ab Imperatore Claudio praefes, siue
procurator Iudaeae, Samariae quoq; & Galilaeae, & regionis quae
dicitur trans Iordanē, anno mundi 4015. post Christū natum
53. Tertullus coram hoc praeside Paulum accusauit, Paulus vicis-
sim pro se contra Tertullū causam dixit: quibus auditis distulit
iudicium Felix in aduentum tribuni Lysiae. Hic Felix frequen-
ter accersens Paulum, loquebatur cum eo, & audiuit ab eo fidē
quae est in Christum Iesum. Disputante autem Paulo de iudicio
futuro, tremefactus Felix noluit vltra attendere, sed distulit in
alium diē: simul sperabat quōd pecunia ei daretur a Paulo. De
huius auaritia, & factione cum Ventidio, qua, glisceret pernicie,
arsisset bello prouincia, ni Quadratus Syriae rector subuenisset,
vide Cor. Taci. li. Anna. 12. item quatenus ad alia, vide Act. 24.
ca. Eusc. li. 2. ca. 20 Iosc. li. Antiq. 20. cap. 9.
DRVSILLA Agrippae soror, Aziazi Emesorū siue Ama-
zorū Regis vxor cūm esset, & pulchritudine caeteris praestaret,
Felix eam cocupiuit: quare misso nuntio, eam in suam partem
flexit: nam haec spōte relicto priore marito, huius nuptias secu-
ta est. Vide. Ioseph. li. Antiq. 20. cap. 9.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed inside the woodcuts and are copied as far as legible: "PRAEFECT." and "FELIX ... IVD" on the left, "DRVSILLA" and "FEL. V" on the right. The final letters of the legends are doubtful. "Eusc." and "Iosc." are read as printed; they may be misprints for Euseb. and Ios. The line "Bbb 2" is an uncertain signature reading. The bottom ornament has no text. Some letters in "glisceret", "Iordanē" and "Tertullū" are slightly blurred but read as printed.
